scenarios.title: The Team Leader Talk
scenarios.text: {coach} asks you to speak up more in team meetings.

choices.label: Speak up
choices.result: You speak up the next meeting, short and clear. People listen.

choices.label: Speak when it counts
choices.result: You agree to speak when you have something only a kicker can see.

choices.label: Talk one on one
choices.result: You do it your way: one teammate at a time, after practice.

scenarios.title: The Team Trip Abroad
scenarios.text: The club plays a game overseas, and the trip is a week long.

choices.label: See the city with teammates
choices.result: You see the city with the specialists. It's the best road trip of your career.

choices.label: Keep your routine
choices.result: You keep your routine to the minute. It's a little lonely and very steady.

choices.label: Plan for the time change
choices.result: You shift your sleep a week early. You land ready.

scenarios.title: The Jet Lag Game
scenarios.text: You're kicking in a different time zone, and your body hasn't noticed yet.

choices.label: Follow the sleep plan
choices.result: You follow the trainers' sleep plan exactly. By game day, you feel almost normal.

choices.label: Kick it awake
choices.result: You kick extra the first morning to wake your legs up.

choices.label: Sleep when you can
choices.result: You sleep whenever you can and stop worrying about the clock.

scenarios.title: The Contract Bonus
scenarios.text: You hit a contract bonus, and your agent wants you to celebrate quietly.

choices.label: Put it away
choices.result: You put it straight into savings and tell almost nobody.

choices.label: Treat the specialists
choices.result: You treat the specialists to a nice dinner. Nobody posts about it.

choices.label: Celebrate at home
choices.result: You celebrate at home with takeout and a movie.

scenarios.title: The Wedding Planning
scenarios.text: Wedding planning during the season, and every decision is a phone call.

choices.label: Take every call
choices.result: You take every call, even between meetings. {love_interest} feels it.

choices.label: Hire a planner
choices.result: You hire a planner and make the big decisions on Mondays.

choices.label: Leave it to {love_interest}
choices.result: You leave most of it to {love_interest} until the offseason.

scenarios.title: The House Party You Host
scenarios.text: You host a team party at your new house, and by ten o'clock it's twice as big as planned. There are people in your backyard you've never met.

choices.label: Set the rules early
choices.result: You set the rules at the door: rides home, nothing stupid, done by midnight. Everyone respects them, and the night stays fun.

choices.label: Enjoy it
choices.result: You let it run and enjoy it. Half the team is in your backyard, laughing, and you've never felt more like one of them.

choices.label: Shut it down early
choices.result: You shut it down early when it gets too big. A few teammates grumble on the way out, and nobody calls the police.

scenarios.title: Your Old Coach Visits
scenarios.text: Your college special teams coach visits practice and watches every kick.

choices.label: Spend the day with him
choices.result: You spend the day with him. He tells stories about you that you'd forgotten.

choices.label: Ask for his notes
choices.result: You ask for his notes. He has a page, and one line is gold.

choices.label: Show him your best
choices.result: You show him your best practice of the year.

scenarios.title: The Ball Boy
scenarios.text: A ball boy who's been here as long as you have is going to college.

choices.label: Throw him a send-off
choices.result: You and the specialists throw him a send-off in the equipment room.

choices.label: Write him a letter
choices.result: You write him a recommendation letter. He gets the scholarship.

choices.label: Shake his hand
choices.result: You shake his hand and wish him luck.

scenarios.title: The Scrapbook
scenarios.text: {parent} keeps a scrapbook of every article about you, and shows you.

choices.label: Go through it together
choices.result: You go through every page together. It takes the whole evening.

choices.label: Help them digitize it
choices.result: You help scan it so nothing gets lost.

choices.label: Look at your favorites
choices.result: You look at a few favorites and laugh at your old haircut.

scenarios.title: The Fan Who Grew Up
scenarios.text: A kid who held a sign at your first practice is now in high school and kicking.

choices.label: Invite him to practice
choices.result: You invite him to watch practice and hold a session after.

choices.label: Send him a message
choices.result: You send a message: the sign is still on your fridge.

choices.label: Watch from afar
choices.result: You watch his videos and smile.

scenarios.title: The Fitness Test
scenarios.text: The club's offseason fitness test: shuttle runs, a mile, a jump. You're not where you were, the strength coach writes your times down without comment, and the linemen are watching.

choices.label: Train for the retest
choices.result: Three weeks of training for the retest, and you pass it clean, faster than last year. The linemen cheer, sarcastically and then sincerely.

choices.label: Explain kicking fitness
choices.result: Your leg numbers, shown to the trainers: kicking fitness isn't running fitness. They agree, mostly, and adjust your test for next year.

choices.label: Accept the number
choices.result: The number is the number. You accept it calmly and plan a better summer, and the strength coach nods, clearly surprised.

scenarios.title: The Pet
scenarios.text: You get a dog, and it changes your schedule more than you expected.

choices.label: Enjoy the walks
choices.result: You enjoy the morning walks. They're the calmest part of your day.

choices.label: Bring the dog to the facility
choices.result: You bring the dog to the facility on Fridays. It becomes the team's dog.

choices.label: Set a routine
choices.result: You build the dog into your routine. Everyone's happier.

scenarios.title: The Retirement Account
scenarios.text: Your advisor finally gets you to open a retirement account.

choices.label: Do it right
choices.result: You do it right and set it to grow on its own.

choices.label: Ask {parent} what they wish they'd done
choices.result: You ask {parent} what they wish they'd done. It's a long, honest talk.

choices.label: Do the minimum
choices.result: You do the minimum and forget about it.
